desc:
• PIE CRUST: Enjoy delicious pie crust in a few simple steps; each 11-oz. bag makes two 9-inch pie crusts

  • QUICK AND EASY: Add cold water to pie crust mix, cut into two halves, roll and bake

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Fill pie dough with your favorite fruits and flavors

  • CROWD-PLEASING DESSERT: There are pie options for everyone with this super tasty and versatile Betty Crocker pie crust mix

  • PICNICS AND MORE: Easy pie crust makes your next pie a no-brainer for celebrations, everyday dinners and lunches

  • BOX TOPS FOR EDUCATION PARTICIPATING PRODUCT: Give back to schools with Betty Crocker; Download the Box Tops App to learn more & start earning cash for your school or a school in need
features:
Features of Betty Crocker Pie Crust Mix

Yields Two 9-Inch Crusts
Each 11 oz. pack makes two flaky, tender pie crusts—perfect for double-crust pies or two single-crust recipes.

Quick and Easy Prep
Just add cold water, mix, roll, and bake. Ready to use in minutes—no need for extra ingredients or complicated steps.

Flaky and Tender Texture
Made with a blend of enriched flour and shortening to deliver a consistently light, golden-brown crust.

Versatile for Sweet and Savory Dishes
Works great for fruit pies, cream pies, quiches, tarts, pot pies, and more.

Beginner-Friendly
Foolproof instructions make it ideal for novice bakers or anyone short on time.

Clean Ingredient Profile
No high-fructose corn syrup, kosher certified, and suitable for everyday home use.

Pantry-Friendly Size
Compact, easy-to-store pouch—convenient to keep on hand for last-minute baking.

Benefits

Saves Time Without Sacrificing Quality
Delivers homemade-style crust in a fraction of the time, with no stress or mess.

Delicious Every Time
Reliable texture and taste ensure your pies look and taste bakery-perfect.

Perfect for Holiday Baking or Weeknight Meals
From Thanksgiving pies to everyday quiches, this crust mix fits any occasion.

Customizable
Easy to add spices, cheese, herbs, or sugar for your unique twist.

Kid-Approved and Family-Friendly
Simple to prepare—fun for kids to help roll and shape into their favorite recipes.

Great Value
Affordable and convenient, with trusted Betty Crocker quality in every pack.
ingredients: ENRICHED FLOUR BLEACHED (WHEAT FLOUR, NIACIN, IRON, THIAMIN MONONITRATE, RIBOFLAVIN, FOLIC ACID), PALM OIL, CORN STARCH, SALT, CORN SYRUP SOLIDS, SODIUM CASEINATE, DIPOTASSIUM PHOSPHATE, COLOR ADDED.
